design: After local or total adjective-position MLP3 interaction removal, restore native period MLP4 output, or native adjective/period/both source contributions to attention5 final write, or full attention5 final write. Source rescue adds native contribution minus currently perturbed contribution, retaining other sources and native attention bus. Each rescue has paired random delta controls norm-matched to its actual correction.
native_controls: Run every rescue on unablated prompts as an identity check, with matched nearzero random deltas. Include each ablation without rescue.
metrics: Native-reference KL and intended-margin loss; fraction of ablation margin loss recovered and KL remaining relative to no-rescue ablation. These are conditional intervention effects, not unique mediation percentages or additive path fractions.
scope: Locked panel; only four familiar original-format quartets pass native gate. Whole-source and whole-write rescues restore more than just factorial interaction, so interpret as route capacity, not identification of an exclusive mechanism. No training or reserved test.
